metadata.title: Bulk Ingestion at Scale
metadata.topic_note: Slot-1 kicker is the FIXED claude-hai series name (runtime/qc/brand_labels.json, GATE L rule 7) — never a per-video guess. The project identifier lives in the segment title and the description.
metadata.greeting_note: hello lexicon: Swedish (short form). HAI persona takes only the shortest cues (Hi · Ola · Hej · Ciao) per the ai-explainer word budget. Rotated off week 1's 'Ola' so the channel does not repeat a language within the series.
metadata.color_semantics: Claude FIDELITY skin: cream #F2F0E9 stage, warm ink #3D3929, terracotta #D97757 as the ONE accent — one terracotta moment per beat. The source Mycroft figures used crimson #C8102E for the data series and ochre #C8860E for annotation; both remap onto the Claude accent grammar (terracotta = data series and single focal moment, ink = structure, muted ink = de-emphasis). Palette change only, no data change. Same treatment as week 1.
metadata.derived_from: narration_script.md (human-authored, 438 spoken words, target 2:55). Every on-screen figure is drawn from figdata_week2.json, which the Mycroft repo queries directly from the built Parquet — no number is typed by hand, so a chart cannot drift from the panel it describes.
metadata.note: ai-explainer / claude-hai. ILLUSTRATE LAW: the Claude UI appears at B00 (cold open, answered), B08 (verdict artifact), B09 (handoff) and B10 (outro) only — every body beat illustrates its concept as a native animated Remotion scene (REBUILD LAW). The three source PNGs in pantry/ are REFERENCE for the rebuild, never slotted as media; their SVG sources travel with them. The script pairs two traps in one shot and puts the staircase and the archive-lag problem on one figure; both are split here so each beat carries one idea.
